import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import lightgbm as lgb

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Split features and target
X = train_df.drop(columns=["target", "id"])
y = train_df["target"].values
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=["id"])

# Feature columns
continuous_cols = [
    col for col in X.columns
    if X[col].dtype in ['float64', 'int64'] and col not in ["f_29", "f_30"]
]
int_cols = ["f_29", "f_30"]
string_col = "f_27"

# Process string feature with ordinal encoding
ord_enc = OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown="use_encoded_value", unknown_value=-1)
X_string = ord_enc.fit_transform(X[[string_col]])
X_test_string = ord_enc.transform(X_test[[string_col]])

# Process integer features with one-hot encoding
X_int = pd.get_dummies(X[int_cols], columns=int_cols, sparse=True)
X_test_int = pd.get_dummies(X_test[int_cols], columns=int_cols, sparse=True)

# Ensure same columns in train and test
X_int, X_test_int = X_int.align(X_test_int, join='left', axis=1, fill_value=0)

# Process continuous features (just standardize)
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_cont = scaler.fit_transform(X[continuous_cols])
X_test_cont = scaler.transform(X_test[continuous_cols])

# Combine all features
X_combined = hstack([csr_matrix(X_cont), csr_matrix(X_string), csr_matrix(X_int)]
X_test_combined = hstack([csr_matrix(X_test_cont), csr_matrix(X_test_string), csr_matrix(X_test_int)])

# Train/validation split (90/10)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_combined, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Train LightGBM model
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    objective='binary',
    metric='auc',
    device='cpu',
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42
)

# Train with early stopping
model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)])

# Predict on validation set and compute AUC-ROC
val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"AUC-ROC: {auc_score:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission["target"] = test_pred
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
